correctness.rationale: The seven-state finite absorbing CTMC gives exact rational mean hitting time; independently constructed five-state equations match 60 rational seven-state instances. The symbolic seven-state endpoint-rate symmetrization difference factors into positive polynomial numerator/denominator certificates (55 and 16 positive coefficients), proving an unrestricted global symmetry reduction. The quintic derivative has exactly one sign variation and opposite signs at t=1/2 and t=1, certifying the unique global optimizer for all positive rates. Exact asymptotic coefficients and rational benchmark inequalities are verified by the packaged 103-assertion script. No finite simulation substitutes for an all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural full classification of a fixed-budget mean epidemic-lifetime problem on the smallest connected nonregular network, not a recomputation at an arbitrary parameter point. The strict hub allocation range for all infection strengths, unique exact optimizer with two asymptotic expansions, and proof that a familiar threshold-optimal allocation is never extinction-time optimal provide independently useful analytic benchmarks for finite SIS resource-placement heuristics. The all-allocations symmetrization lemma removes a nontrivial assumption. Its idealized size and dynamics limit direct field generalization but do not remove mathematical value.
